services.name: Maverick Fly By Oside-Parasailing Adventure
services.desc: Get ready for a breathtaking experience! 1 Hour About Experience the thrill of the Maverick Fly By Oside Parasailing Adventure—our 800ft parasailing adventure over Oceanside's stunning coastline! Fun and safe for ages 6 and up, you can choose to stay dry or get a little wet. Soar high above the ocean and take in breathtaking views while feeling the rush of adrenaline. Non-flyers can still join the fun with our Observer Pass, enjoying the ride from the boat. Perfect for families, friends, and adventure seekers, this is the ultimate way to create lasting memories. Book your flight Ages 6+ • 1 Hour Ride • 800 feet! - Up to 6 people
